contentPattern.structure: icon + short description paragraph (no title, no link)

suitableFor: 'things you need to know' / eligibility info cards on application pages
informational icon-card grids where each card is a small icon plus one short descriptive sentence
note/fact tiles with icon + short text, non-navigational, on a light background
notSuitableFor: cards that need a distinct title plus a description paragraph (use cards-cover)
navigational tiles where the whole card is a link (use cards-overview or cards-cta)
checklist rows of icon + short label (use cards-checklist)
